scenarios.title: A clean cut
scenarios.story: A reads a shared pool, reasons for a long time, then writes a private claim. B updates the pool and writes its own claim. The only conflict joins the two first pieces.

scenarios.title: A cut that must not be made
scenarios.story: Both agents read the replica count, reason, and write a new count derived from it. Cutting at the reasoning gap would let both read 4 and one update vanish.

scenarios.title: A replan that is harmless
scenarios.story: A reads x and commits. Only then does it decide to write a notes object it never declared. Nobody else touches that object.

scenarios.title: A replan that needs the future regrouped
scenarios.story: A reads x and commits, then decides to write y, which B also plans to write. As chopped, the new plan has a cycle. B has not started, so both futures can still be merged.

scenarios.title: A replan that cannot be made safe
scenarios.story: A reads x and commits. B writes x and reads y in one piece and commits. Only then does A decide to write y. The cycle runs through A's committed read.
